Implementation complete. Ready for review of clinical age format changes including: (1) Clinical age-format rules for all age ranges, (2) Tooltip with full age breakdown on hover, (3) Comprehensive unit and E2E tests, (4) Lint fixes.

Fix 4 blocker issues identified in review: (1) Test expectations incorrect for non-abbreviated format - tests expect 'Y', 'mo' suffixes when calling formatPatientAge(patient) without abbreviated=true, should expect 'years', 'months' instead (affects lines 530, 537-538, 547-548, 553-554, 562-563, 568-569, 574-575, 580-581 in formatPatientAge.spec.ts); (2) Test expectations incorrect for abbreviated format spacing - tests expect '2Y', '18Y' but implementation returns '2 Y', '18 Y' with space (lines 531, 563, 569, 575, 581); (3) PLAYWRIGHT_GUIDE.md formatting corrupted at lines 231-248 - multiple template strings concatenated on single lines; (4) Test description at line 462 doesn't match implementation - says '5 weeks 0 days' but implementation returns '5 weeks' only when remainingDays is 0.
